extDescription.message: Delete history, cookies and cache of only the sites you choose: on visit, when the tab closes or on a schedule. The rest stays.

notWebHint.message: Open the site you want, then click the icon again

domainTooBroad.message: $1 is a shared domain zone used by many sites — add a specific site instead (e.g. example.$1)

noSites.message: No sites in the list yet

sweepTargetsLabel.message: Delete now will clear the history of

sweepAllShort.message: Delete history of all listed sites

reasonBoot.message: Cleaned up leftovers at browser start

dataTitle.message: Also delete this site's cookies, cache and site data when its last tab closes. You'll be signed out of it. Cookies are removed for the whole main domain.

dataAria.message: Also delete cookies and site data of $1

addDataLabel.message: Also delete cookies and site data when the tab closes (signs you out of the site)

sweepDataNote.message: Also cleared cookies and site data of $1 sites.

scheduleDesc.message: Deletes the full history of every site in your list on a schedule, even if its tab is open, plus the cookies of sites that aren't open.

welcomeDesc.message: Pick the sites you don't want in your history. Everything else stays as it is.

welcomeStep1.message: Add a site below, for example one you log in to but don't want in your history.

welcomeStep2.message: Choose Delete on visit (nothing is ever kept) or Delete on tab close (kept while you use the site).

welcomeStep3.message: Optional: also delete its cookies, hide site names, or set a scheduled clean. Pin the icon from the puzzle-piece menu to see the count.

popupUnsupported.message: This browser version can't open the popup automatically

headline.message: Sites to keep out of history

domainPlaceholder.message: Type a domain or paste a URL, e.g. youtube.com

hintDefault.message: A main domain also covers all of its subdomains

hintWillDelete.message: Will delete the history of $1 and $2

emptyList.message: No sites yet — add your first one above

hideNamesDesc.message: Shows •••••• instead of names here and in the popup, so people looking at your screen can't see them. Click the eye to peek.

autoSweepDesc.message: For "Delete on visit" sites, in case anything slips through. Only scans recent history, so it stays light.

badgeDesc.message: Items deleted since the browser started

popupDesc.message: The popup drops down from the icon and closes after 4 seconds. Delete on visit: at most once per site every 5 minutes.

sweepNowDesc.message: Deletes all past history of these sites (both modes), plus the cookies of sites with + cookies on. Other sites are not touched.

sweepAllBtn.message: Delete all history in the list

backupDesc.message: Save your site list and settings to a .json file to keep a backup or move them to another computer. The file is plain text, so anyone who opens it can read your site names. Keep it somewhere safe.

importTooLarge.message: This file is too large to be an AutoClean History backup (max $1 KB)

importWrongFormat.message: This isn't an AutoClean History backup file

importNewer.message: This backup was made by a newer version of AutoClean History. Update the extension first.

importTooMany.message: That would be more than $1 sites, which is over the limit

importEmpty.message: There are no usable sites or settings in this file

importSummaryMerge.message: $1 new sites will be added. $2 already in your list keep their current mode.

importSummaryReplace.message: Your list will become the $1 sites in this file. $2 sites not in the file will be removed, and $3 will change mode.

importSkipped.message: $1 entries were skipped because they aren't valid sites, or are shared zones like co.th.

importVisitWarn.message: Right after importing, all past history of these $1 sites will be deleted (Delete on visit). This can't be undone.

importWithSettings.message: Also import settings (re-sweep interval, notifications, hide names, language)

importLangNote.message: The new language applies when you reopen this page.

visitLi1.message: Deletes every page as you visit it — nothing stays in history

visitLi2.message: Also re-sweeps when the tab closes (same as having both modes on)

visitLi3.message: Re-sweeps on the interval above and when the browser starts

closeLi1.message: History stays while you use the site, and is deleted when its tab closes

closeLi2.message: Several tabs open → deleted when the last one closes

closeLi3.message: Closed the whole browser at once → cleaned up at next start

footnote.message: Everything stays on this device. AutoClean History sends no data anywhere and only deletes data of the sites in your list.
